name: Naruse Yuuki
source:
"Hmm, I wonder if I could do 100 push-ups" 

 A student at Seijou School. An expert with an air rifle. Rouga said he "would become more reliable than Heita". That face, those fingers, that neck... Really, he looks kinda like a girl... He wants to become strong and muscular like Rouga. 

Battle quote - "Umm, I wonder where I should aim for..."
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
